research_object: forecast-conditioned physical interception commitment under delayed target manoeuvre
fixed_physical_items: target sensing, communication, and MAPPO interface

new_task_semantics.public_dispatch_advisory: At reset, every actor receives the same probability that the target will execute a rightward branch manoeuvre.
new_task_semantics.truth_boundary: The sampled branch identity is not emitted before the physical branch step. Before that step both target trajectories are identical.
new_task_semantics.memory_boundary: The advisory is emitted for the initial decision slot only; later actors receive an uninformative advisory until the physical manoeuvre begins.
new_task_semantics.commitment: Early lateral 3DOF motion may improve future interception geometry but makes a later reversal physically costly. No macro action, route label, or privileged controller state is added.
new_task_semantics.target_branch: After the fixed branch step the target executes a bounded left or right heading change through the existing target kinematics.

g0_required_evidence: A legal history-dependent controller can use the initial public advisory without reading environment state.
For at least one reliable context, advisory-aligned early physical positioning improves terminal intercept feasibility relative to waiting.
For the ambiguous context, waiting or a neutral positioning policy is not dominated by the same early directional commitment.
The target branch is physically absent from all actor observations before the fixed branch step.
No context has universal success or universal failure under the legal controller family.
prohibited_shortcuts: actor access to sampled branch identity before branch step
reward for matching the hidden future branch
controller reads of red_pos, red_heading, or other environment state not present in actor history
post-hoc adjustment of geometry after G0 results
future_comparison_boundary: No method is named or trained by this contract. Any future method must keep actor observations, action interface, reward, dynamics, budget and endpoint tapes matched against a plain recurrent MAPPO baseline.
